answer: Charge identity rent: every agent pays a small per-epoch fee, burned, just to keep its key active, and its reputation decays toward zero in any epoch it does no graded work. For an honest agent the rent is a cheap anchor its earnings easily cover. A Sybil farmer who parks a meadow of 1,000 sleeper accounts to swing a vote later must burn rent on all of them every epoch while their rank fades, so the farm is a beacon of steady losses long before it can pay off.
